hypotheses.name: CatchUP storage I/O degradation
hypotheses.description: CatchUP recording failures may be caused by slow or unstable storage writes.

evidence.statement: Elevated storage I/O latency supports storage-path degradation.
CatchUP recording failures are consistent with storage-path degradation.

required_confirmation_evidence: Inspect write latency and I/O error evidence.
Verify service improvement after storage remediation.

hypotheses.name: CatchUP storage capacity saturation
hypotheses.description: CatchUP recording failures may be caused by insufficient free storage capacity.

evidence.statement: High storage utilization supports a possible storage-capacity saturation hypothesis.

required_confirmation_evidence: Verify free capacity or allocation limit.
Verify whether freeing capacity restores recording.

hypotheses.name: CatchUP application or recording-worker failure
hypotheses.description: The service may be failing independently of storage capacity or storage performance.
required_confirmation_evidence: Verify worker health and restart behaviour.

ranked_diagnostics.name: Inspect CatchUP storage capacity and growth
ranked_diagnostics.question: What are current free capacity, recent growth rate, retention cleanup status, and allocation limits?

ranked_diagnostics.name: Inspect storage I/O health
ranked_diagnostics.question: Are write latency, I/O queue depth, filesystem errors, or disk errors abnormal?

ranked_diagnostics.name: Inspect CatchUP recording-worker health
ranked_diagnostics.question: Are recording workers running, restarting, blocked, or reporting exceptions?

recommended_interventions.name: Inspect storage I/O and hardware health
recommended_interventions.rationale: Elevated I/O latency and recording failures may indicate storage-path degradation.
recommended_interventions.expected_effect: Identify whether latency comes from saturation, filesystem errors, hardware problems, or queueing.
recommended_interventions.verification_test: Inspect disk health, filesystem errors, queue depth, and write throughput.

recommended_interventions.name: Inspect and validate CatchUP storage capacity
recommended_interventions.rationale: The current evidence suggests storage capacity may be contributing to recording failures.
recommended_interventions.expected_effect: Determine whether storage capacity is genuinely constraining CatchUP recording.
recommended_interventions.verification_test: Confirm free capacity, growth rate, cleanup state, and allocation limits.

recommended_interventions.name: Adjust retention or expand storage after approval
recommended_interventions.rationale: If capacity saturation is confirmed, storage demand must be reduced or capacity increased.
recommended_interventions.expected_effect: Restore stable CatchUP recording and prevent capacity exhaustion.
recommended_interventions.rollback_plan: Restore the previous retention policy or remove the newly introduced storage configuration if the change causes degradation.
recommended_interventions.verification_test: Compare recording success, storage utilization, and write latency before and after the intervention.

conclusion: The current leading hypothesis is 'CatchUP storage I/O degradation'. This is not a confirmed root cause. Additional diagnostic evidence is required.
